data.summary: ThemeToggle instances now stay in sync: they subscribe to THEME_CHANGE_EVENT and 'storage' events, and system-change handling goes through a new tested subscribeToSystemTheme helper that reads the latest preference lazily. Charts now use readable text, grid and legend colors in dark mode. Tests and build were not run; I could not execute commands in this environment.

changedFiles.purpose: Listen to THEME_CHANGE_EVENT and storage events; use subscribeToSystemTheme with a preference ref
Add subscribeToSystemTheme(matchMedia, doc, getPreference) returning an unsubscribe function
Tests for event dispatch in setTheme and for subscribeToSystemTheme
Dark-aware chart text/grid/legend colors, tracked via a MutationObserver on html class

testsAdded.description: setTheme dispatches THEME_CHANGE_EVENT with the stored value; subscribeToSystemTheme toggles dark for system, ignores light/dark preference, and stops after unsubscribe

appliedFeedback: Added a THEME_CHANGE_EVENT listener in ThemeToggle that sets the preference from event.detail, with cleanup on unmount.
Added a 'storage' listener for THEME_STORAGE_KEY that re-reads the stored theme, updates state and calls applyTheme.
select() keeps setPreference + setTheme; the event dispatch in theme.js is kept and now has a consumer.
Added a setTheme dispatch test that stubs globalThis.window and CustomEvent and restores them afterwards.
Extracted subscribeToSystemTheme into theme.js, used it in ThemeToggle, and unit-tested it with a fake matchMedia.
InvestmentGraphModal chart text, axis, legend and grid colors now follow the dark class, observed through a MutationObserver on documentElement, which also covers system changes.
npm test and npm run build still need to be run by the factory.

selfVerification.notes: No command execution was available, so tests and build were not run. Code was written to follow existing patterns.

followUps: Chart tooltip custom HTML (getCustomTooltip) is not themed for dark mode.
